name: asset_add
description: Add one fixed asset to the register and return its id with the rate, useful life and convention taken from the bundled tax table. Cost and residual are whole minor units. Free tier holds ten assets.

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: What the asset is, e.g. "MacBook Pro 16" or "Delivery van"

arguments.name: scheme
arguments.desc: "pl" Polish KST annex rates, "uk" HMRC capital allowance pools, "us" IRS MACRS GDS. Omit to derive it from the shared business profile currency

arguments.name: category
arguments.desc: A code or name from the bundled table, e.g. "487" or "Computers and computer sets" (pl), "main" (uk), "5-year" (us). Read assets://categories for the list

arguments.name: cost_minor
arguments.desc: Acquisition cost in MINOR units (integer cents/grosze), e.g. 549900 for 5499.00. Never a decimal

arguments.name: currency
arguments.desc: ISO code. Defaults to the shared business profile currency, else the scheme table currency

arguments.name: purchase_date
arguments.desc: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD the asset was bought

arguments.name: in_service_date
arguments.desc: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD the asset entered use and the register. Defaults to purchase_date

arguments.name: residual_minor
arguments.desc: Residual or salvage value in MINOR units, default 0. Must be less than cost. MACRS ignores it and the answer says so

arguments.name: method
arguments.desc: "straight-line" or "declining-balance". Default: the table row method, straight-line for the Polish annex and the reducing-balance pool rate for the UK

arguments.name: life_years
arguments.desc: Override the useful life derived from the table, in years. The answer reports that it was an override

arguments.name: rate_pct
arguments.desc: Override the annual percentage derived from the table. Use for a lowered Polish rate under art. 16i

arguments.name: declining_coefficient
arguments.desc: Declining-balance coefficient. Polish default 2.0, capped by the table; ignored with straight-line

arguments.name: project
arguments.desc: Project, department or cost centre this asset belongs to

name: asset_list
description: List the assets in the register with cost, method, rate and net book value at a date, filtered by scheme, category, project, currency or disposal state. Free and unlimited.

arguments.name: scheme
arguments.desc: Only assets on this tax scheme

arguments.name: category
arguments.desc: Only assets in this table category code or name

arguments.name: project
arguments.desc: Only assets on this project or cost centre

arguments.name: currency
arguments.desc: Only assets held in this currency

arguments.name: as_of
arguments.desc: Value the register at this month or date, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Default today

arguments.name: include_disposed
arguments.desc: Include assets already disposed of. Default false

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum rows, default and ceiling 2000

name: asset_schedule
description: Build the depreciation schedule for a stored asset, or price one not yet in the register, per year or per month, to zero or residual, with the table convention applied and the periods summing exactly to the base. Free.

arguments.name: asset
arguments.desc: Asset id such as ASSET-2026-0001, or an exact or partial name. Omit and pass the fields below to price an asset that is not in the register

arguments.name: scheme
arguments.desc: Scheme, when pricing an asset that is not in the register

arguments.name: category
arguments.desc: Table category code or name, when pricing an asset that is not in the register

arguments.name: cost_minor
arguments.desc: Cost in MINOR units, when pricing an asset that is not in the register

arguments.name: currency
arguments.desc: ISO code, when pricing an asset that is not in the register

arguments.name: purchase_date
arguments.desc: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, when pricing an asset that is not in the register

arguments.name: in_service_date
arguments.desc: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD the asset entered use. Defaults to purchase_date

arguments.name: residual_minor
arguments.desc: Residual in MINOR units, default 0

arguments.name: method
arguments.desc: "straight-line" or "declining-balance"

arguments.name: life_years
arguments.desc: Override the useful life from the table, in years

arguments.name: rate_pct
arguments.desc: Override the annual percentage from the table

arguments.name: declining_coefficient
arguments.desc: Declining-balance coefficient; ignored with straight-line

arguments.name: granularity
arguments.desc: "year" for one row per period, "month" for the monthly charge. Default "year"

name: asset_journal
description: Return the depreciation journal for one month: debit depreciation expense and credit accumulated depreciation, per asset and in total, plus an expense_add-ready payload per currency. It writes nothing itself. Pro.

arguments.name: month
arguments.desc: The month to journal, YYYY-MM. A date YYYY-MM-DD is read as its month

arguments.name: scheme
arguments.desc: Only assets on this tax scheme

arguments.name: project
arguments.desc: Only assets on this project or cost centre

arguments.name: expense_account
arguments.desc: Debit account name. Default "Depreciation expense"

arguments.name: accumulated_account
arguments.desc: Credit account name. Default "Accumulated depreciation"

arguments.name: category
arguments.desc: Expense category to put on the expense_add payload. Default "depreciation"

name: asset_dispose
description: Record the sale, scrapping or write-off of an asset on a date for a proceeds amount, and return the gain or loss against net book value at that date. Free.

arguments.name: asset
arguments.desc: Asset id such as ASSET-2026-0001, or an exact or partial name

arguments.name: date
arguments.desc: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD the asset left the business. It cannot be before the in-service date

arguments.name: proceeds_minor
arguments.desc: Sale proceeds in MINOR units, default 0 for a scrapping or a write-off

arguments.name: note
arguments.desc: What happened, e.g. sold to a dealer, written off after a fire

name: asset_report
description: Report net book value by category and currency at a date, the year's depreciation charge, and every disposal in the year with its gain or loss. Pro.

arguments.name: year
arguments.desc: Calendar year to report, e.g. 2026. Default the year of as_of, else this year

arguments.name: as_of
arguments.desc: Value the register at this month or date, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Default the last day of the year

arguments.name: scheme
arguments.desc: Only assets on this tax scheme

arguments.name: project
arguments.desc: Only assets on this project or cost centre

name: license_status
description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

name: license_activate
description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.

arguments.name: key
arguments.desc: License key from the checkout confirmation page
